_comment: Airspace definitions for the ATC trainer. Coordinates are [lat, lon] in decimal degrees (WGS84). Altitudes are feet. Edit per airfield; the Python code reads this file at startup.
_attribution: Kutaisi CTR geometry derived from Master Arms (https://wiki.masterarms.se/index.php/Airport_Procedures), a Swedish DCS community. Their model: CTR surface..1500 ft AGL, TMA 1500 ft MSL..10000 ft, CTA 10000 ft MSL..UNL.
